cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: EV high-voltage cables are orange. Before repair, the high-voltage system must be isolated using the service disconnect and insulated tools.

why.en: Hundreds of volts can kill.

recall_q.en: Colour of high-voltage cables in EVs?

explain_simple.en: Orange cable = danger, high voltage.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: A hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) has both an IC engine and an electric motor with a battery.

why.en: Combines engine range with electric efficiency.

recall_q.en: What two power sources does a hybrid have?

explain_simple.en: Hybrid = engine + motor.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Series hybrid: the engine only drives a generator; the motor alone drives the wheels. A range-extender EV is a series hybrid.

why.en: Engine runs at its best speed always.

recall_q.en: In which hybrid does the engine never drive the wheels directly?

explain_simple.en: Series: engine makes power, motor drives.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Parallel hybrid: both the engine and the motor can drive the wheels, alone or together.

why.en: Motor helps the engine when extra power is needed.

recall_q.en: In which hybrid can both engine and motor drive the wheels?

explain_simple.en: Parallel: both push the car.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Series-parallel (power split) hybrid uses a planetary gear set to mix engine and motor power. Toyota's hybrid system is an example.

why.en: It gets the best of both types.

recall_q.en: Which gear set splits power in a series-parallel hybrid?

explain_simple.en: Planetary gear mixes engine and motor.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Mild hybrid: a small motor (often 48 V starter-generator) helps the engine but cannot drive the car alone. Strong (full) hybrid can drive short distances on electricity only.

why.en: PSC trap: mild hybrids cannot run in pure electric mode.

recall_q.en: Can a mild hybrid run on electric power alone?

explain_simple.en: Mild helps; strong can drive alone.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Plug-in hybrid (PHEV) has a bigger battery that can be charged from the grid. It drives some distance on electricity, then uses the engine.

why.en: Short daily trips can be fully electric.

recall_q.en: Which hybrid can be charged from a wall socket?

explain_simple.en: PHEV = hybrid you can plug in.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Hybrid parts: IC engine, motor-generator, battery pack, power control unit (inverter), and power split device or transmission.

why.en: These manage the flow between engine, battery and wheels.

recall_q.en: Name two main parts of a hybrid vehicle.

recall_a.en: Engine, motor-generator, battery, power control unit.

explain_simple.en: Engine, motor, battery, controller.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Fuel cell electric vehicle (FCEV) makes electricity from hydrogen and oxygen in a fuel cell. The only exhaust is water.

why.en: Fast refuelling and long range, but hydrogen is costly.

recall_q.en: Only exhaust from a hydrogen fuel cell vehicle?

explain_simple.en: Hydrogen in, water out.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: FAME India scheme (Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles) gave subsidies: FAME I from 2015, FAME II from 2019 (₹10,000 crore).

why.en: To make EVs cheaper to buy.

recall_q.en: Full form of FAME?

recall_a.en: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of (Hybrid &) Electric Vehicles.

explain_simple.en: FAME = EV subsidy scheme.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: PM E-DRIVE scheme (2024) replaced FAME II to support e-two-wheelers, e-three-wheelers, e-buses and charging stations.

why.en: Continues government support for EVs.

recall_q.en: Which scheme followed FAME II in 2024?

explain_simple.en: FAME II then PM E-DRIVE.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Other EV support: GST on EVs 5% (petrol cars up to 28%), no registration fee for battery vehicles, permit exemption for battery-operated transport vehicles, and green plates.

why.en: Lower costs push people to buy EVs.

recall_q.en: GST rate on electric vehicles?

explain_simple.en: EVs taxed only 5%.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: National Electric Mobility Mission Plan (NEMMP) 2020 was launched in 2013. Kerala brought its own EV policy in 2019.

why.en: Long-term plans for EV growth.

recall_q.en: Year NEMMP 2020 was launched?

explain_simple.en: NEMMP 2013 started the EV push.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Low-speed e-scooters with top speed up to 25 km/h and motor up to 250 W are not 'motor vehicles' under CMVR. They need no registration or licence.

why.en: PSC trap on what counts as a motor vehicle.

recall_q.en: Does a 250 W, 25 km/h e-scooter need registration?

explain_simple.en: Slow small e-scooter: no RC, no DL.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: E-rickshaw and e-cart were added by the 2015 amendment (Section 2A). Top speed is up to 25 km/h; an e-rickshaw carries up to 4 passengers and 40 kg luggage.

why.en: Brought these vehicles under law.

recall_q.en: Maximum speed of an e-rickshaw?

explain_simple.en: E-rickshaw: slow, 4 passengers.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

learn.en: Old petrol or diesel vehicles can be converted to EV or hybrid with approved retrofit kits (AIS-123), and the change is entered in the RC.

why.en: Allows cleaner use of existing vehicles.

recall_q.en: Can a diesel car be legally converted to electric?

recall_a.en: Yes, with an approved retrofit kit, endorsed in the RC.

explain_simple.en: Approved kit and RC update.

cards.source: Kerala PSC AMVI syllabus, Cat. No. 517/2022 — Electric and hybrid vehicles; standard diploma textbook

points.en: BEV: battery, BMS, inverter, motor, single-speed gear.
Range = kWh ÷ Wh/km; charge time = kWh ÷ kW.
Series: engine only generates; parallel: both drive; PHEV plugs in.
Mild hybrid cannot run on electricity alone.
FAME I 2015, FAME II 2019, PM E-DRIVE 2024; GST 5%.
